Hi Rishi,

Quick update — our on-site week just got compressed. Senior leadership added an extra customer tour on Dec 16 and several folks will be traveling between our sites Dec 15–18.

That means the afternoon blocks you proposed are now a problem for several stakeholders (including Sakura and Ben, who are core decision makers). I attached the updated travel itinerary so you can see the overlaps.

We still want a thorough walkthrough, but it looks like the most practical approach for the week is:
- Record a short (20–25 min) walkthrough focused on the admin + routing flows so our team can review asynchronously
- Schedule two 45-minute office hours sessions (one for APAC-friendly timing, one for US) during the following week for live Q&A and hands-on followups

Can you confirm if you can record a focused demo we can watch before the office hours, and share one or two possible slots for the Q&A the week of Dec 20? If you prefer, we can take a quick 15-min sync to align on the recording outline first.

Appreciate the flexibility — Samantha

Thanks for the heads up, Samantha — totally understandable. We can do the recording + office hours approach.

Plan we propose:
1) Short focused walkthrough recording (20–25 minutes) that covers: onboarding flow, routing policies, and the Dedicated failover behavior you asked about. We can include a short appendix showing token-level cost breakdown for a sample workload.
2) Two live office hours:
   - US session: Tue, Dec 21 at 10:00 AM PT (45 min)
   - APAC-friendly session: Wed, Dec 22 at 02:00 AM PT / 7:00 AM CET to catch your EMEA folks (we can flip if you prefer a later APAC time)
3) Pre-demo sync: If you want the recording to cover specific prompts or datasets, happy to do a 15-min call tomorrow to align.

We can deliver the recording as a private Drive link; we’ll also attach a one-page runbook with recommended routing and batching suggestions tailored to the use case you shared. Karthik and Monica will help run the office hours and handle the Ops/infra questions.

If that sounds good, I’ll record on Friday afternoon (Dec 18) and share the link by EOD Dec 18 so you have time to review before the Dec 21 office hours.

Thanks — Rishi
